summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing the launch of HEMANGEOL (propranolol) Oral Solution, the only FDA-approved treatment for infantile hemangioma. The company announced the product is available exclusively through Anovo Specialty Pharmacy with integrated Eton Cares patient support including $0 co-pay for eligible commercially insured patients. No financial terms, price, or transaction structure were disclosed. This is a product relaunch and commercial update, not a corporate event. Watch for prescription uptake and revenue impact in subsequent quarters.
